categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the development, manufacturing, and sales of test and measurement instruments and meters. Its product lines include general instruments, professional instruments, temperature and environmental testing instruments, and testing instruments. The company also engages in ODM services and e-commerce sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced safety protection, high-efficiency sampling and digital signal processing, automatic calibration, stable and fast voltage boosting, and image processing algorithms for infrared thermal imaging. The company employs proprietary ADC chips, DDS signal generation, and AI-enhanced image algorithms. Production is carried out in modern manufacturing bases in Dongguan, Heyuan, and Vietnam, with a mix of make-to-stock and make-to-order models.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers span wireless communications, automotive electronics, semiconductor chips, aerospace, scientific research, certification testing, new energy, and power supply industries. The company serves both domestic and international markets, including Europe, America, and Asia-Pacific regions, with customers mainly being distributors and end-users in industrial and research sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases in Dongguan, Heyuan, and Vietnam. It has subsidiaries and branches in Hong Kong, Germany, the United States, and Vietnam, serving over 80 countries and regions globally. Major markets include domestic China and overseas developed and emerging economies.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and sales of test and measurement instruments. It procures key components like ICs, PCBs, and sensors from multiple suppliers and delivers finished products to distributors and end customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment to enhance product competitiveness, focusing on high-end instruments such as high-bandwidth oscilloscopes, RF analyzers, power supplies, and thermal imagers. The company emphasizes core technology breakthroughs, AI integration, and localization of key components. It also pursues global production capacity expansion and deepens industry-academia collaborations.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales under the company's own brand and ODM services. Sales channels include domestic distributors, overseas distributors, direct e-commerce platforms, and other customers. The company also earns investment income from financial assets.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with global leaders like Fluke and Keysight Technologies. It holds a strong domestic market position with a comprehensive product portfolio and recognized brand 'UNI-T'. It is regarded as a leading domestic manufacturer with advanced R&D capabilities and a growing international presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.13 billion, a 10.81% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 183.4 million, up 13.64%. R&D investment accounted for over 10% of revenue. The company has steadily expanded production capacity and sales channels, with assets totaling RMB 1.7 billion and a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-safety, high-reliability, and cost-effective test and measurement products with broad application coverage. Its competitive differentiation lies in advanced proprietary technologies, comprehensive product lines covering multiple measurement domains, strong R&D and innovation capabilities, and localized manufacturing to ensure supply stability and responsiveness. The integration of AI and smart features in products further enhances customer value.
